name: Modern Anime (Qwen-Image)
means: Intended as a modern-anime look for Qwen. On this box it does not currently produce one.
verdict: MEASURED. At strength 1.0 it did nothing - the render was the render. Not subtly weaker, not a different flavour: no visible change. Most likely it needs a trigger word, or it is on the wrong base revision. See the note; the two candidates are narrowed but not decided.
note: base_model READ FROM THE HEADER, and the header is the problem: ss_sd_model_name = 'qwen_image_bf16.safetensors', modelspec.date = 2025-08-13. This is a delta against ORIGINAL Qwen-Image, while the box runs qwen_image_2512_fp8. Same 60-block geometry, so it loads silently and cleanly and reports no error - the WRONG-REVISION failure mode, which is far quieter than wrong-architecture and is the reason base_model must be read as a revision and not just a family. | WHAT WAS RULED OUT: the key-name hypothesis. This file uses sd-scripts flattened names (lora_unet_transformer_blocks_N_...) rather than the dotted form the other Qwen LoRAs use. All 840 of its module names map 1:1 onto the key map ComfyUI builds at comfy/lora.py:194-195, verified by string-matching them against the proven-working illustration LoRA's module set: 840 matched, 0 unmatched. IT ATTACHES. The no-op is not a loading failure. | WHAT REMAINS, untested: (a) wrong base revision as above, (b) a missing trigger word. The metadata is the richest in the set at 46 keys - ss_network_dim 32, ss_network_alpha 1, 1141 train items, 3426 steps, AdamW8bit at lr 2e-4 - but it carries NO ss_tag_frequency and no trigger_phrase, so there is no caption evidence to read. Deciding between (a) and (b) needs a render, not more header reading. | trigger is recorded as empty because that is what a consumer must send today, but treat it as UNKNOWN rather than none - absence of a trigger_phrase key is not evidence that no trigger exists. | Alpha 1 over rank 32 gives effective scale 0.03125, the lowest in the set. DO NOT read that as the explanation for the no-op: in sd-scripts the alpha/dim factor is applied during training as well as inference, so the learned weights compensate and 1.0 reproduces the trained effect. The number invites exactly that wrong conclusion, which is why it is written down here. | strength_range starts at the value already measured to do nothing, so the range is really a suggestion to try ABOVE 1.0 - untried.
